damped_angular_frequency.q: A 2 kg mass on a spring with a spring constant of 50 N/m has a damping coefficient of 4 kg/s. What is the damped angular frequency?
A damped oscillator has mass 1 kg, spring constant 10 N/m and damping coefficient 2 kg/s. Find its damped angular frequency.

damping_ratio.q: A damped oscillator has a 2 kg mass, a spring constant of 50 N/m and a damping coefficient of 4 kg/s. What is the damping ratio?
Find the damping ratio of a damped spring system with mass 1 kg, spring constant 10 N/m and damping coefficient 2 kg/s.

quality_factor.q: What is the quality factor of a damped oscillator with mass 2 kg, spring constant 50 N/m and damping coefficient 4 kg/s?
A damped oscillator has a 1 kg mass, a spring constant of 100 N/m and a damping coefficient of 0.5 kg/s. Find its quality factor.

driven_amplitude.q: A 2 kg mass on a spring with spring constant 50 N/m and damping coefficient 4 kg/s is driven by a periodic force of amplitude 10 N at a driving frequency of 3 rad/s. What is the steady-state amplitude?
A driven oscillator of mass 1 kg has spring constant 20 N/m and damping coefficient 1 kg/s. The driving force amplitude is 2 N and the driving frequency is 4 rad/s. Find the steady-state amplitude.

amplitude_resonance_frequency.q: A driven oscillator has mass 2 kg, spring constant 50 N/m and damping coefficient 4 kg/s. What is its amplitude resonance frequency?
Find the amplitude resonance frequency of a driven damped oscillator with mass 1 kg, spring constant 10 N/m and damping coefficient 2 kg/s.

coupled_fast_mode.q: Two identical masses of 2 kg are each attached to a wall by a spring of spring constant 40 N/m and joined by a coupling spring of 10 N/m. What is the higher normal mode frequency?
Two coupled oscillators have masses of 1 kg each, outer spring constant 8 N/m and coupling spring constant 4 N/m. Find the higher normal-mode frequency.

physical_pendulum_period.q: A physical pendulum of mass 2 kg has a moment of inertia of 0.5 kg*m^2 about its pivot, and the distance from the pivot to the center of mass is 0.3 m. What is its period?
Find the period of a compound pendulum of mass 3 kg with moment of inertia 1.2 kg*m^2 and a distance from the pivot to the center of mass of 0.25 m.

double_pendulum_slow_mode.q: A double pendulum has equal masses and a length of each arm of 1 m. What is the lower normal mode frequency?
Find the lower normal-mode frequency of a double pendulum whose arm length is 0.5 m.

double_pendulum_fast_mode.q: A double pendulum has equal masses and a length of each arm of 1 m. What is the higher normal mode frequency?
Find the higher normal-mode frequency of a double pendulum whose arm length is 0.5 m.

vis_viva.q: A satellite on an elliptical orbit around a planet of mass 5.972e24 kg has a semi-major axis of 8.0e6 m. What is its orbital speed at a distance from the center of 7.0e6 m?
A comet orbits a star of mass 1.989e30 kg with a semi-major axis of 2.0e11 m. Find its orbital speed at a distance from the center of 1.5e11 m.

escape_speed.q: What is the escape speed from a planet of mass 5.972e24 kg and radius 6.371e6 m?
Find the escape velocity at the surface of a moon with a mass of 7.342e22 kg and a radius of 1.737e6 m.

kepler_period_semi_major.q: A planet orbits a star of mass 1.989e30 kg on an elliptical orbit with a semi-major axis of 1.496e11 m. What is its orbital period?
Find the orbital period of a satellite on an elliptical orbit around a planet of mass 5.972e24 kg with a semi-major axis of 4.2164e7 m.

inertia_solid_sphere.q: A uniform solid sphere has a mass of 2 kg and a radius of 0.5 m. What is its moment of inertia about its center?
Find the moment of inertia of a solid sphere of mass 5 kg and radius 0.2 m about its central axis.

inertia_hollow_sphere.q: A uniform hollow sphere has a mass of 2 kg and a radius of 0.5 m. What is its moment of inertia about its center?
Find the moment of inertia of a hollow sphere of mass 5 kg and radius 0.2 m about its central axis.

inertia_solid_disk.q: A uniform solid disk has a mass of 2 kg and a radius of 0.5 m. What is its moment of inertia about its center?
Find the moment of inertia of a solid disk of mass 5 kg and radius 0.2 m about its central axis.

inertia_rod_center.q: A uniform rod of mass 3 kg and length 2 m rotates about its center. What is its moment of inertia?
Find the moment of inertia of a thin rod of mass 0.6 kg and length 1 m about its center.

inertia_rod_end.q: A uniform rod of mass 3 kg and length 2 m rotates about one end. What is its moment of inertia?
Find the moment of inertia of a thin rod of mass 0.6 kg and length 1 m about one end.

rolling_incline_acceleration.q: A cylinder of mass 2 kg and radius 0.2 m with a moment of inertia of 0.04 kg*m^2 rolls without slipping down an incline. The angle of the incline is 30 degrees. What is its acceleration?
A wheel rolls without slipping down a slope inclined at 20 degrees. It has mass 4 kg, radius 0.5 m and moment of inertia 0.5 kg*m^2. Find its acceleration.

atwood_massive_pulley.q: In an Atwood machine the heavier mass is 3 kg and the lighter mass is 2 kg. They hang over a pulley with a moment of inertia of 0.02 kg*m^2 and a radius of 0.1 m. What is the acceleration of the masses?
Find the acceleration of an Atwood machine whose heavier mass is 5 kg and lighter mass is 1 kg, hung over a pulley of radius 0.5 m with a moment of inertia of 0.5 kg*m^2.

torque_free_precession.q: A torque-free symmetric body spins with a spin angular velocity of 10 rad/s. Its transverse moment of inertia is 2 kg*m^2 and its moment of inertia about the symmetry axis is 3 kg*m^2. What is the precession rate?
In deep space a symmetric rigid body has a spin rate of 4 rad/s, a transverse moment of inertia of 1 kg*m^2 and an axial moment of inertia of 1.5 kg*m^2. Find its precession rate.

foucault_precession_period.q: A Foucault pendulum swings in Paris at a latitude of 48.85 degrees. What is its precession period?
Find the precession period of a Foucault pendulum at the North Pole, latitude 90 degrees.

bead_hoop_equilibrium.q: A bead slides without friction on a rotating hoop of radius 0.2 m. The hoop rotates at 10 rad/s about its vertical diameter. What is the equilibrium angle of the bead?
A bead on a hoop of radius 1 m rotating at 5 rad/s about a vertical diameter: find the equilibrium angle.

elastic_collision_first_final.q: In an elastic collision the first mass is 2 kg with a velocity of the first of 3 m/s, and the second mass is 1 kg with a velocity of the second of 0 m/s. What is the final velocity of the first?
Two carts collide elastically: the first mass is 1 kg and the velocity of the first is 4 m/s; the second mass is 3 kg and the velocity of the second is -2 m/s. Find the final velocity of the first.

elastic_collision_second_final.q: In an elastic collision the first mass is 2 kg with a velocity of the first of 3 m/s, and the second mass is 1 kg with a velocity of the second of 0 m/s. What is the final velocity of the second?
Two carts collide elastically: the first mass is 1 kg and the velocity of the first is 4 m/s; the second mass is 3 kg and the velocity of the second is -2 m/s. Find the final velocity of the second.

rocket_delta_v.q: A rocket with an exhaust velocity of 3000 m/s has an initial mass of 1000 kg and a final mass of 400 kg after the burn. What is its change in velocity?
Find the delta-v of a rocket whose exhaust speed is 4400 m/s, with an initial mass of 50000 kg and a final mass of 10000 kg.
